items.title: Jordan Addison: Needs thumb surgery, IR possible
items.text:
Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that Addison will require surgery on his thumb and will miss a few weeks, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: T.J. Hockenson: Expected to progress ahead of Week 11 action
items.text:
Coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that the Vikings expect Hockenson (wrist/chest) to make progress ahead of Sunday's game against the 49ers, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Drake London: Cleared of head injury
items.text:
Head coach Kevin Stefanski said Monday that London was cleared of a concussion near the end of Sunday's 35-13 loss to the Chiefs, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Sam Darnold: Trending toward Week 12 return
items.text:
Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that he's "really optimistic" Darnold (quadriceps/ribs) will be able to get a full week's worth of practice coming out of the Seahawks' Week 11 bye and start their next game Nov. 29 against the 49ers, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tommy DeVito: Could continue to fill in for Maye
items.text:
Mike Reiss of ESPN notes via ESPN's Adam Schefter that there are fears  DeVito's teammate, Drake Maye, may have sustained a fractured ankle during Week 10 action.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
